location_description: Reading ( RED-ing; Pennsylvania Dutch: Reddin) is a city in and the county seat of Berks County, Pennsylvania. The city had a population of 95,112 as of the 2020 census. It is the fourth-largest city in Pennsylvania after Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, and Allentown.
